text.card: A red giant 3,168 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.01 solar masses and 9.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,739 K at its surface.
